title: MAD-Fact: A Multi-Agent Debate Framework for Long-Form Factuality Evaluation in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the factuality verification accuracy of single-model evaluators against a multi-agent debate framework (MAD-Fact) to identify and mitigate systematic biases and inconsistent judgments inherent in standard LLM-as-a-judge systems.

Comparing the long-form factuality performance of various LLMs on an English dataset (LongFact) versus a newly constructed Chinese dataset (LongHalluQA) to detect multilingual capability imbalances and disparities in handling culturally specific content.
